reason: Safe bounded cleanup cannot be established within the allowed files: after the leader is reaped, the binding clarification forbids signaling its PID or PGID, while descendants may survive in that group or escape it with setsid. astra_disposition: Confirmed blocker. No patch or tests. A future card requires pre-spawn containment that covers escaped descendants, or an explicitly narrowed supported-command contract.
